name: Psychic Whisper
description: The creature targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or take 25 (6d6 + 4) psychic damage and be stunned until the end of the creature’s next turn as incomprehensible whispers fill the target’s mind.
